metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: Since you loved the comedic ensemble chemistry and workplace antics of Scrubs and Community, this highly-rated comfort show about a quirky police precinct is the perfect fit.

metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: A superb comfort watch that matches the uplifting, heartwarming, and comedic vibes of Ted Lasso, with an iconic ensemble cast you will fall in love with.

metas.name: The Office (US)
metas.description: Matches the awkward, brilliant character-driven humor of Silicon Valley and Arrested Development, providing endless rewatchable background comfort.

metas.name: Spaced
metas.description: An essential British cult comedy featuring geek culture references and surreal humor that will appeal directly to fans of Peep Show and Community.

metas.name: Stath Lets Flats
metas.description: If you enjoyed the chaotic, cringe-inducing British comedy of PhoneShop and Peep Show, this hilarious sitcom about a terrible lettings agent is right up your alley.

metas.name: Archer
metas.description: This clever, fast-paced adult animated comedy shares the high-concept, cynical wit and fantastic voice acting of Rick and Morty and Futurama.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: A wholesome, lighthearted animated family sitcom that captures the cozy, heartwarming, and funny family dynamics seen in King of the Hill and The Simpsons.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: An incredibly funny, mockumentary-style look at vampire roommates that matches the dark, hilarious energy of It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: Like Arrested Development, it deals with a wealthy family who loses their fortune, but matches the warm, feel-good growth found in Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Broad City
metas.description: Captures the chaotic, hilarious friendship dynamics and wild misadventures in New York City, perfect for fans of New Girl and It's Always Sunny.

metas.name: Veep
metas.description: Offers incredibly sharp, rapid-fire political insults and workplace satire that matches the cynical, brilliant writing of Silicon Valley and Arrested Development.

metas.name: Peacemaker
metas.description: A hilariously irreverent, action-packed sci-fi comedy with a great soundtrack, appealing to fans of One-Punch Man and Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Our Flag Means Death
metas.description: A heartwarming, quirky historical adventure comedy that captures the whimsical spirit of ONE PIECE and the feel-good humor of Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Flight of the Conchords
metas.description: This beloved musical comedy shares the dry, offbeat humor of Peep Show and the unique, artistic charm of Master of None.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: A classic British geek sitcom that perfectly bridges the nerdy tech-world jokes of Silicon Valley with the comfort of traditional sitcom structures.

metas.name: Father Ted
metas.description: An essential piece of surreal British/Irish comedy history that fans of classic, absurd television like Goodness Gracious Me will adore.

metas.name: Workaholics
metas.description: Fans of the slacker comedy and low-stakes debauchery of Top Buzzer and It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia will love this high-energy workplace sitcom.

metas.name: Derry Girls
metas.description: A brilliant, laugh-out-loud comedy about five high schoolers in 1990s Northern Ireland, matching the energetic ensemble charm of Community and Brassic.

metas.name: Cougar Town
metas.description: Created by the same mind behind Scrubs and Ted Lasso, this breezy, highly comforting sitcom features a tight-knit friend group obsessed with wine and silly games.

metas.name: Shrinking
metas.description: Co-created by the Ted Lasso team and Bill Lawrence (Scrubs), this heartwarming comedy about a grieving therapist delivers the perfect mix of tears and laughs.

metas.name: Psych
metas.description: A highly comforting, hilarious blue-sky detective comedy filled with endless pop-culture references, perfect for fans of Dirk Gently and Scrubs.

metas.name: Party Down
metas.description: A brilliant cult comedy about a group of cynical caterers chasing fame, delivering the same dry, deadpan workplace satire as Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Ghosts (UK)
metas.description: A delightfully warm, clever, and comforting British comedy about a young couple inheriting a haunted house, appealing to fans of The Good Place.

metas.name: Abbott Elementary
metas.description: A highly rated, warm, and hilarious workplace mockumentary that captures the heart and easygoing comfort of modern sitcoms.

metas.name: Harley Quinn
metas.description: An incredibly funny, chaotic adult animated action-comedy that matches the sci-fi craziness of Rick and Morty and the subversion of One-Punch Man.

metas.name: Mob Psycho 100
metas.description: From the creator of One-Punch Man, this beautiful animation is incredibly funny, filled with stunning action, and features a highly heartwarming story.

metas.name: The Inbetweeners
metas.description: A legendary British comedy about awkward teenagers, nailing the absolute peak of cringe comedy and banter found in Peep Show and PhoneShop.

metas.name: Taskmaster
metas.description: If you love comforting British television like Gogglebox, this brilliant comedy game show is the ultimate lighthearted, laugh-out-loud comfort watch.

metas.name: The Venture Bros.
metas.description: A brilliantly written, long-running animated sci-fi parody that perfectly scratches the same itch as Futurama and Rick and Morty.

metas.name: Superstore
metas.description: An incredibly reliable and funny background comedy that shares the colorful cast and easy-to-watch structure of New Girl and Scrubs.

metas.name: Better Off Ted
metas.description: A highly rated, criminally overlooked corporate satire that captures the high-energy comedy of Arrested Development and the tech cynicism of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Dave
metas.description: An inventive, funny, and sometimes poignant comedy-drama about an aspiring rapper, fitting right alongside the vibe of Master of None and Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Nathan for You
metas.description: For anyone who loves the brilliant social awkwardness and extreme cringe humor of Peep Show and Silicon Valley, this real-life business satire is a must-watch.

metas.name: Mythic Quest
metas.description: Created by the team behind It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia, this workplace comedy about a video game studio is a perfect blend of geek-culture and humor.

metas.name: Modern Family
metas.description: The quintessential family comfort sitcom. Its fast-paced mockumentary style is perfect for fans of Arrested Development who want something lighter.

metas.name: Catastrophe
metas.description: A hilariously raw, smart, and witty romantic comedy set in London that fans of Master of None and high-quality British comedy will love.

metas.name: Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt
metas.description: An incredibly colorful, fast-paced, and endlessly optimistic comedy from Tina Fey that will delight fans of The Good Place and Community.

metas.name: Extraordinary
metas.description: A fun, modern British comedy about a world where everyone gets a superpower except the main character. It's quirky, light, and perfect for Dirk Gently fans.

metas.name: Star Trek: Lower Decks
metas.description: A fast-paced, loving sci-fi parody that hits all the same comedic, space-adventure beats as Futurama and Rick and Morty.

metas.name: The Great British Baking Show
metas.description: The ultimate feel-good background TV show. If you love Gogglebox and need a cozy, stress-free, and delightful reality competition, this is it.
